48cab1a9-637d-450d-9d01-99ddee4f6b3b.art: A great bonfire encircled by a shimmering ring of translucent multicolored flame, ghostly firelight reflecting in the wide entranced eyes of motionless figures standing hypnotized in a darkened hall.

481cbfeb-d5b9-47f7-8aa6-af123fbb4b82.rules: Emanates an invisible cone of supernatural dread. Creatures caught within must save or flee in panic away from the caster at maximum movement for 1 round per caster level, dropping everything held or carried. Creatures of 6+ HD/levels save at +2; those under 1 HD are automatically affected with no save. Cornered fleeing creatures get a new save each round to break the effect.
481cbfeb-d5b9-47f7-8aa6-af123fbb4b82.art: A robed figure thrusts out a hand as a translucent shimmering cone of dark psychic energy fans outward, warriors within it dropping their weapons and fleeing wide-eyed in blind terror, shadows lengthening and clawing at their heels.

stats.area_of_effect: 18.3 m cone, 9 m wide at end

49167a52-a134-4f16-b8ff-a0e0018784c1.rules: Creates an item of nonliving, plant-based material—cloth, rope, wood, leather, paper, or similar vegetable matter. The caster must have at least a tiny piece of the material to be made as a focus. Up to about 0.03 cubic meters of matter per level may be created. The item is real while it lasts, then vanishes. Cannot produce animal or mineral substances such as meat, metal, stone, or gems.
49167a52-a134-4f16-b8ff-a0e0018784c1.art: A wizard's outstretched hands weave glowing threads of green-gold light that spin and knit themselves into a coil of rope and folds of woven cloth, motes of leaf-like sparks drifting away as the objects take solid form.

07dc7c7d-85d0-402d-89f5-e39428932649.rules: Alters the appearance of natural terrain, making one type seem like another (fields as forests, roads as swamps, etc.), complete with matching sounds and smells. Physical contact does not dispel it, but a creature that touches or interacts and actively disbelieves is allowed a save to see through it. May hide pits, obstacles, or safe paths. Affects only terrain features, not creatures or structures. Persists until dispelled.
07dc7c7d-85d0-402d-89f5-e39428932649.art: A dusty caravan road shimmering into a fetid black swamp with hanging mist and phantom reeds, travelers hesitating at the edge as the true dry path faintly ghosts beneath the illusory bog.

f5713a52-58d9-4ff8-9d38-a9775baa4d03.rules: Creates the image of a wall, floor, ceiling, or door up to 3m x 3m x 30cm that appears wholly real, blocking sight and even offering faint tactile resistance to a light touch. The illusion cannot be disbelieved by observation alone, but any creature that firmly presses or resolutely walks into or through it passes without harm and recognizes it as false. Blocks vision and normal detection until dispelled or physically penetrated.
f5713a52-58d9-4ff8-9d38-a9775baa4d03.art: A cracked stone corridor sealed by a seemingly solid grey wall, an armored adventurer's outstretched hand sinking eerily through its surface as faint shimmering ripples betray the deception, torchlight glinting off a fragment of green jade on the floor.

68acc5d3-7e11-46aa-bc5d-88452228cfdf.rules: Creates a sturdy cottage or lodge of local stone, timber, or sod, with a level, clean, dry floor. Includes a sturdy door, two or more shuttered windows, and a small fireplace. As strong as stone; resists fire and normal missiles (not siege/giant missiles). Door and shutters are wizard locked; chimney has an iron grate and narrow flue. These three points carry an alarm spell. An unseen servant is conjured to serve the caster.
68acc5d3-7e11-46aa-bc5d-88452228cfdf.art: A snug stone cottage shimmering into existence on a windswept hillside, warm light glowing through shuttered windows as a faint translucent servant stacks logs by the door, magical wards glimmering faintly around the frame.

bd43644c-6ff2-4a79-96c7-c9b515f72e9d.rules: Transforms a finely wrought polished silver mirror (worth at least 1,000 gp) into a scrying device functioning like a crystal ball, letting the caster view distant persons or places (resolve as a crystal ball, per DMG). The subject retains the standard crystal ball chance to detect the scrying. Certain spells may be cast through the mirror: comprehend languages, read magic, tongues, and infravision function normally;
bd43644c-6ff2-4a79-96c7-c9b515f72e9d.art: A tall silver mirror in a candlelit study, its glassy surface glowing with a swirling window onto a distant moonlit castle, ghostly light spilling across the sorcerer's face.

ab302179-eb54-4dc3-b77c-d8ea1b542b27.rules: Creates an invisible, mobile sensor that transmits sight to the caster's mind, relaying infravision if the caster possesses it. The eye flies and looks around corners, moving 9 m/rd. (18 m/rd. if only moving in a straight line, per some interpretations); it passes through openings as small as 2.5 cm but not solid barriers. It has 1 hp and AC 18. Detect magic or true seeing reveals it; dispel magic destroys it.
ab302179-eb54-4dc3-b77c-d8ea1b542b27.art: A shimmering translucent orb of arcane sight drifts silently down a torchlit dungeon corridor, peering around a stone corner while faint threads of ghostly light connect it back toward a distant seated mage lost in trance.

742b8f00-c699-4ee4-8c55-110151d5e0c5.rules: Makes up to 10 man-sized (or smaller) willing creatures per level appear as trees or bushes. Transformed creatures remain conscious and can see and hear but cannot move, speak, or take action. They are indistinguishable from real vegetation except by true seeing or detect magic. Damage dealt to a disguised creature affects it normally. The caster may end the effect at will; it also ends via dispel magic. Larger creatures count as multiples of man-sized.
742b8f00-c699-4ee4-8c55-110151d5e0c5.art: A marching column of armored soldiers frozen mid-stride and blossoming into a silent grove of oaks and shrubs, faint spectral faces flickering within the bark under dappled forest light.

80b55b7c-a2de-45b3-b7d7-7d05eb43c2e4.rules: Affects living creatures, making those that fail regard the caster as a trusted friend and ally, obeying reasonable requests within their nature (weighing self-endangering or clearly harmful orders normally). Affects 2d4 HD of creatures; a single target of 4+ HD is affected regardless of the roll. Wisdom adjustments to the save apply. Hostile action by the caster ends the charm or grants a new save.
80b55b7c-a2de-45b3-b7d7-7d05eb43c2e4.art: A towering horned beast bows its head in serene devotion beside a robed mage, its once-savage eyes softened by a shimmering rose-gold glow that curls between them like silken threads in a torchlit cavern.

377e38eb-dd55-4285-9dc3-c629910c6872.rules: Summons 1d6 2nd-level monsters within range 1d4 rds. after casting. They appear anywhere in the area and attack the caster's foes until slain, dismissed, or duration ends. They never check morale and vanish when killed.
377e38eb-dd55-4285-9dc3-c629910c6872.art: A swirling vortex of arcane light tears open in a torchlit dungeon corridor, disgorging a snarling pack of summoned beasts that lunge toward unseen enemies as their bodies shimmer half-formed from the ether.

7a3a0a84-de02-4c1e-ac38-c4a1aea1e80f.rules: Summons 1d6 second-level monsters of a type chosen by the DM, appearing 1d4 rounds after casting at a spot the caster designates and fighting on the caster's next action. They obey simple mental commands (attack, guard, follow, retreat) and serve until slain or the spell ends. If no enemies are present they attack whatever the caster directs. Cannot be summoned into solid objects or spaces too small to hold them.
7a3a0a84-de02-4c1e-ac38-c4a1aea1e80f.art: A shimmering circle of arcane light tears open in a torchlit dungeon hall as six snarling beasts materialize from swirling motes, fangs bared and claws ready, their forms coalescing from luminous smoke around a robed conjurer.

7f944329-710b-4401-bc5e-5ce1cc47ce6e.rules: Encloses a single creature in a globe of shimmering force. The subject may voluntarily fail its save to be protected; otherwise a successful save negates the effect. The sphere is immune to all physical and magical attacks from either side, save that Disintegrate destroys it and Dispel Magic collapses it. Nothing passes the barrier except air, so the trapped creature cannot move, attack, cast, or hurl anything, but breathes freely.
7f944329-710b-4401-bc5e-5ce1cc47ce6e.art: A warrior frozen mid-stride inside a glassy, faintly glowing translucent orb, fists uselessly pressed against the curved inner wall as spears and fireballs burst harmlessly against its shimmering surface.

0f2c7a47-3ef1-466f-8f10-a5b04c67d299.rules: Causes normal vegetation to grow densely into an impassable thicket of briars, brush, and creepers covering a square area of up to 9 sq m per caster level (the caster shapes the boundaries as desired). Man-sized creatures are slowed to 3 m/round while forcing through; larger creatures to 1.5 m/round; small creatures cannot pass at all. Serves as a barricade or trap. Requires existing plants—useless on bare stone, desert, or barren ground.
0f2c7a47-3ef1-466f-8f10-a5b04c67d299.art: A tangled wall of thorned briars and vines erupts skyward across a forest clearing, choking the path as gnarled branches interlace into an impenetrable green barricade.

b7b3a111-5be2-4634-b3ac-4a51b0bab7f6.rules: Fashions a deadly phantom drawn from the victim's own subconscious fears, visible and real only to the target. Each round the victim may attempt to disbelieve; success (aided by high Wisdom/Intelligence bonuses) dispels the phantasm. The killer attacks as AC -4 versus the target. If it strikes, the victim must save or die instantly of fright; a successful save instead inflicts 3d6 points of damage. The phantom cannot be harmed by others, existing only in the target's mind.
b7b3a111-5be2-4634-b3ac-4a51b0bab7f6.art: A cowering warrior recoils in terror from a shadowy nightmare-beast conjured from his own mind, its clawed shape flickering half-real in dim torchlight while unseen companions stand oblivious beside him.

7087f549-a18b-461b-af2b-568384106c3e.rules: Caster assumes the shape of any known nonmagical creature, from toad-sized up to twice the caster's size. Gains the form's movement modes, senses, natural armor, and physical attacks, but keeps his own hit points, THAC0, saves, and mind. No spellcasting or magical/special abilities; spells with only a V component may be cast if the form can speak. Adopting a form radically unlike the caster's may require a system shock survival roll or the change fails.
7087f549-a18b-461b-af2b-568384106c3e.art: A robed mage caught mid-transformation, his outstretched arms sprouting feathers as skin ripples into an eagle's plumage, wings unfurling in a swirl of shimmering arcane light, feet elongating into talons.

b99c1ffc-5a1a-4354-bc75-831ebb547c7e.rules: The recipient's flesh hardens, negating the next 1d4+1 physical attacks (weapon blows, claws, bites, thrown objects, falls, and crushing), regardless of the damage each would deal. Each such attack expends one charge. Magical attacks (fireball, lightning bolt, magic missile, etc.) are not blocked and do not consume charges. Protection ends when all charges are spent or the spell is dispelled. Multiple castings on one creature are not cumulative.
b99c1ffc-5a1a-4354-bc75-831ebb547c7e.art: A lone warrior stands amid a hail of arrows and axe blows, skin gleaming like polished grey granite as blades shatter and shafts splinter harmlessly against the stony surface, faint dust motes of diamond and rock swirling around the impacts.

b0eb2bbb-bc39-4f6e-a01b-c243dfb6c895.rules: One creature becomes clumsy and uncoordinated. On a failed save the target immediately falls prone and can neither move nor act that round. Each following round it must make a Dexterity check to perform any action; failure means the attempt goes awry — weapons dropped, spells bungled, movement causing a fall, items fumbled or broken. A successful save reduces the effect: the target merely moves and attacks at half normal rate for the duration rather than falling helpless.
b0eb2bbb-bc39-4f6e-a01b-c243dfb6c895.art: A charging warrior's legs tangle mid-stride as his sword flies from splayed fingers, feet skidding out from under him in a spray of dust, arms flailing helplessly beneath a faint shimmering enchantment.

74d16160-c960-47aa-b5ab-c2e213aaf540.rules: Makes an area appear vacant, neglected, and long abandoned—covering it with illusory dust, cobwebs, dirt, and decay. Observers see false tracks and torn cobwebs as they pass through, and the place seems empty. Only nonliving things are cloaked; living creatures are unaffected and cannot be hidden. Merely brushing an invisible object does not disturb the effect—only forceful contact with a cloaked object may reveal that something unseen is present.
74d16160-c960-47aa-b5ab-c2e213aaf540.art: A pristine treasure chamber overlaid with a shimmering veil of illusion, its polished floors blanketed in phantom dust and drifting cobwebs, gilded objects fading into apparent ruin and decay under a dim, forgotten gloom.

06df83f7-7b13-48f8-ba53-476608af516a.rules: Affects 1d4+1 creatures/level, causing madness. Each affected creature saves at -2 (plus its Wisdom defense adjustment); those that fail become confused. Confused creatures roll 1d10 each round: 1 = wander away for the rest of the effect; 2-6 = stand confused doing nothing; 7-9 = attack the nearest creature; 10 = act normally that round. Creatures attacked by a confused creature may respond as their nature dictates.
06df83f7-7b13-48f8-ba53-476608af516a.art: A cluster of warriors staggering and clutching their heads in a shimmering violet haze, some swinging blades wildly at their own comrades while others stumble away dazed, wisps of spiraling enchantment coiling above them.

b1006d60-5379-447f-a858-1e05cad4e7a7.rules: Turns an ordinary weapon into a magical +1 weapon, granting +1 to attack and damage rolls. Affects either two small weapons (arrows, bolts, daggers) or one large weapon (axe, bow, hammer, sword). Also works on existing magical weapons so long as the total combined bonus does not exceed +3. Enchanted missile weapons lose the enchantment after a successful hit; melee weapons retain it until the effect ends.
b1006d60-5379-447f-a858-1e05cad4e7a7.art: A plain steel longsword held aloft in a candlelit workshop, its blade wreathed in a shimmering silver-blue aura as fine glowing dust settles along the edge and sparks of enchantment dance across the metal.

d81ddb28-19b2-452a-8e5f-c13da6464a4f.rules: Wards a chosen surface or passage (portal, floor, stairs, etc.) so it reacts to any creature over about 1.4 kg. Entering, touching, or contacting the ward without speaking the caster's password triggers a loud ring audible to an 18 m radius, reduced 3 m per interposing door and 6 m per substantial wall. The sound lasts 1 round. Flying, levitating, invisible, incorporeal, or gaseous creatures trigger it; ethereal or astral creatures do not.
d81ddb28-19b2-452a-8e5f-c13da6464a4f.art: A shadowy figure freezes mid-step upon a moonlit stone stairway as a shimmering translucent web of arcane energy flares gold across the steps, ghostly ripples of sound radiating outward through a dim vaulted corridor.

d6da997a-9d74-4d86-988e-0ba266ee94cd.rules: Creates one glowing missile of force that unerringly strikes any target the caster can see and identify; each hits automatically for 1d4+1 damage. An extra missile is gained per two levels beyond 1st: 2 at 3rd, 3 at 5th, 4 at 7th, 5 at 9th (maximum). Multiple missiles may be split among several creatures or concentrated on one. Cannot target inanimate objects or specific body parts; near-total concealment foils it. Wholly negated by a shield spell.
d6da997a-9d74-4d86-988e-0ba266ee94cd.art: Several darts of crackling blue-white arcane energy streak from a mage's outstretched fingertips in curving trails, slamming unerringly into a snarling foe amid bursts of luminous force.

796dd788-880a-46b1-a721-904f7f98b2ad.rules: Creates a billowing yellowish-green gas cloud. Each creature within must save each round or be helpless with choking and retching, unable to act that round. Those who leave the cloud remain nauseated 1d4+1 rounds (-2 to attack rolls and saving throws). A strong wind disperses the cloud in 1 round; otherwise it drifts 3 m/round downwind. Creatures with Hit Dice 2 or more above the caster's level are unaffected.
796dd788-880a-46b1-a721-904f7f98b2ad.art: A thick, roiling cloud of sickly yellow-green vapor pooling low over a stone corridor as armored adventurers stagger and double over, retching, hands clutching their throats amid swirling noxious tendrils.

dcf10ed6-4bd3-44ec-95f0-02b25132533b.rules: A pea-sized bead streaks to the target point and detonates in a burst of flame, dealing 1d6 damage per caster level (maximum 10d6). A successful save halves the damage. The blast bursts, bends around corners, and fills its full volume (about 904 m³ for the standard radius); in an enclosed space too small to contain it, the flames expand into adjacent open areas. It ignites combustibles and may melt soft metals. Damage is not reduced by cover from corners.
dcf10ed6-4bd3-44ec-95f0-02b25132533b.art: A blazing orange-red sphere erupts in a stone dungeon corridor, tongues of fire curling around a corner and licking hungrily along the walls, silhouetted figures thrown back amid billowing smoke and glowing embers.

d37f7fef-2178-411f-b874-976970290d90.rules: A beam of concussive force lashes from the caster's hand, striking all creatures in its path for 5d4 damage +2 per caster level, to a maximum of 5d4+20. A successful save halves the damage. Creatures with amorphous or nonsolid bodies (fire or air elementals, some oozes and slimes) take only half damage, or one-quarter with a successful save.
d37f7fef-2178-411f-b874-976970290d90.art: A searing lance of translucent, rippling force erupts from a wizard's outstretched palm, its shockwave splintering a wooden door and cracking stone walls as caught creatures are hurled back amid a burst of concussive light and flying debris.

7ea460db-8cbd-4d59-a20a-95aca55e328b.rules: Attempts to end ongoing spells and magical effects on a target creature, object, or area. Base success 50%, adjusted +5% per level the caster exceeds the effect's original caster and −5% per level below (min 5%, max 95%). Against magical items, treat the item as 12th level and grant it +2 to resist. When cast on an area, every magical effect present is checked—including the caster's allies' spells. The caster automatically ends his own active spells.
7ea460db-8cbd-4d59-a20a-95aca55e328b.art: A sweeping wave of translucent silver-blue energy rolls across a battlefield, shattering glowing enchantments into dissolving motes as a robed mage thrusts an open palm forward, arcane wards flickering and collapsing around startled combatants.

b036bcc4-a448-4e87-bff3-7fb335e957cc.rules: Excavates 125 cubic m of earth, sand or mud per round (a 1.5 m cube), or expands/starts holes each later round; spoil scatters around the pit. Earth past 6.1 m deep has 15% collapse chance per 1.5 m; sand collapses past 3 m, mud past 1.5 m, quicksand refills instantly. A creature within 0.3 m of a pit falls in unless it makes a Dexterity check; one rushing at a fresh pit falls in on a failed save. Occupants may climb out (DM's rate);
b036bcc4-a448-4e87-bff3-7fb335e957cc.art: A yawning square pit tearing open in a hillside as unseen force flings arcs of dark soil outward, a startled armored figure tumbling over the crumbling brink into the shadowed depths.

d5002d56-d334-44a5-8637-e4d0ceb62e7e.rules: Grants the caster the ability to perform minor, harmless magical tricks and simple tasks. During the spell, the caster can execute one minor effect per round (taking 1 segment each), such as lighting a candle, chilling or warming food, cleaning or dirtying garments, creating small sparks or colored lights, tying loose knots, or spicing a meal. Cantrips cannot deal damage, disrupt concentration, directly alter combat stats, or replicate higher-level spell effects.
d5002d56-d334-44a5-8637-e4d0ceb62e7e.art: A young wizard playfully gestures, causing small glowing orbs, tiny sparks, and a gentle swirl of multicolored sparkles to dance around his fingertips while casually lighting a distant candle.
